Definition: from G3844 and G2334; to overlook or disregard:--neglect.
BiblicalUsage: Paratheoreo means to overlook, to disregard, to neglect. It appears once, in Acts 6:1, where the Grecian widows are neglected in the daily ministration, and the complaint brings the church to choose the seven.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the first deacons were chosen because widows were being overlooked, and the church grows up when it stops neglecting the people at its own table.
